description: Canonical table manifest. Multi-plane: surrealdb_tables (kernel OLTP/evidence) and sqlite_planes (embedded single-writer stores + externally-owned read-only sensors). Coverage test scans all kernel .rs sources; live-DB reconciliation compares manifest vs INFO FOR DB.

policy.new_tables: SCHEMAFULL required — every field typed at declaration
policy.legacy_schemaless: tables listed as schemaless here predate the policy; migration to SCHEMAFULL is tracked per-table, not batch-forced
policy.externally_owned: tables owned by another process (RTK sensor db) are read-only from CYNIC; declared here for inventory completeness
